failures.criterion: Done-when 3: the implementer's `handoff_complete` with verdict pass|pending|fail is recorded against the check and every look is bounded at two hours (CheckLookBound, workflow/check.go:16-22) — for every check of an issue, a rerun's included (workflow/check.go:46-49: a second merge of the same issue replaces the earlier record)
failures.evidence: The check's event ids are keyed on the issue and the look number alone, and a replaced check counts its looks from 1 again while processed_events is never cleared, so a second check of one issue (a child set back to todo after ReenterChild closed the first check, a root reopened inside its linger and merged again) collides with the first: api/handoff.go:199 records a report under `check:<issue>:<looks>:<verdict>`, so the rerun's implementer reporting `pending` on look 1 is answered 409 HANDOFF_ALREADY_RECORDED (`the pending report on look 1 of LEGION-208's production check was already received; this call changed nothing`); daemon/outbox.go:1252 applies a look's bound under `check-look:<issue>:<look>` and :1241 a hold under `check-look-hold:<issue>:<look>`, so the rerun's look-1 bound row is a Duplicate that ends nothing; with no report accepted and no bound, the look stays open, the implementer's pod stays up, and checkBound (check.go:461-463) defers behind the open look. check_bound already keys on its row (`check-bound:<issue>:<row.ID>`, outbox.go:1264) for this reason. Red tests, committed on the issue branch: `LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN=… go test ./internal/api/ -run TestHandoffCompleteTakesAReportOnALaterChecksLookAsANewFact` fails at handoff_test.go:619 with the 409 above; `go test ./internal/daemon/ -run TestACheckLookRowOfALaterCheckEndsThatChecksLook` fails at outbox_check_test.go:273 (`the second check's look 1 is still open after its own bound row ran`). The fix keys the three ids on the check instance (its opened_at, or an id of its own), not the tests.
